name: rx-qr-code
title: QR Code (React)
description: Scannable QR code drawn as one SVG path, colored by tokens (text-foreground on bg-background) with a four-module quiet zone. Props: value, ecc (L, M, Q, H), size (sm, md, lg), aria-label, and a centered icon. Encoded with uqr.
